observed_terms: Information may be copied, published, adapted and extracted with attribution and retained metadata.
Credit INEGI and the source product, with update date where technically possible.
Disclose project analyses or transformations without implying that INEGI performed or endorsed them.
scope_limit: Preflight compares the approved source catalog and accepted Phase 4 report to the official terms page as read on this date. It does not approve a later changed target, every asset member, or the final v1.0.0 release. Raw ZIP and person-level data remain excluded by the project contract.
